jobs.statement: When I open the demo as a judge, I want to immediately see crowd pressure changing, so I can understand the product without setup or explanation.
When congestion starts forming, I want a clear alert with location, severity, and trend, so I can decide where attention is needed.
When data changes source from mock to replay or live, I want that provenance visible, so I can trust what the display means.
When I implement the UI, I want stable aggregate payloads and explicit states, so I can build the dashboard without reverse-engineering backend behavior.
When I present the architecture, I want to show a path from replay to mesh sensing, so I can make the demo feel extensible without live hardware dependency.
When the stream stalls or sensors disappear, I want the UI to degrade visibly, so I can distinguish a real issue from no crowd activity.
